sentences.text: En las vacaciones, Marta y Luis fueron a la casa de su abuela.
sentences.english: In the holidays, Marta and Luis went to their grandmother's house.

sentences.text: Su abuela vivía en un pueblo pequeño.
sentences.english: Their grandmother lived in a small town.
They had to go by bus.

sentences.text: Pedro los llevó a la estación.
sentences.english: Pedro took them to the station.

sentences.text: En la estación compraron los boletos.
sentences.english: At the station they bought the tickets.

sentences.text: Luis tenía un asiento junto a la ventana.
sentences.english: Luis had a seat by the window.

sentences.text: Rosa dijo: —Luis, dale el asiento a tu hermana un rato.
sentences.english: Rosa said, "Luis, give your sister the seat for a while."

sentences.text: Por la ventana vieron montañas, ríos y vacas.
sentences.english: Through the window they saw mountains, rivers and cows.

sentences.text: Marta durmió un rato y Luis leyó un libro.
sentences.english: Marta slept for a while and Luis read a book.

sentences.text: Después de muchas horas llegaron al pueblo.
sentences.english: After many hours they arrived at the town.

sentences.text: La abuela los esperaba en la puerta.
sentences.english: Their grandmother was waiting for them at the door.

sentences.text: —¡Mis niños, qué grandes están! —dijo la abuela, y los abrazó.
sentences.english: "My children, how big you are!" said their grandmother, and hugged them.
